prose: Eileen Day McKusick, author of Tuning The Human Biofield, has innovated techniques and tools for using sound to balance the bio-electric rhythms of the physical and energetic body. We talk about sound and vibration as fundamental elements of the cosmos, the Schumann Resonance, and her upcoming book: Electric Body, Electric Health.
